description: This file implements a cache system for Lua scripts, managing script initialization, loading, and reference counting, specifically used in the context of the lighttpd web server to optimize script execution.

methods.name: __attribute_cold__ __attribute_malloc__ __attribute_returns_nonnull__ script * script_init(void)
methods.description: Allocates and initializes a new script structure, zeroing its memory.

methods.name: __attribute_cold__ void script_free(script * sc)
methods.description: Frees the resources associated with a script, including its Lua state and allocated strings.

methods.name: script_cache_init
methods.description: (Commented out) Initializes a new script cache.

methods.name: void script_cache_free_data(script_cache * p)
methods.description: Frees all scripts in the cache and releases the cache's storage.

methods.name: __attribute_cold__ __attribute_noinline__ lua_State * script_cache_load_script(script * const sc,int etag_flags)
methods.description: Loads a Lua script from disk, updating the script's environment and preparing it for execution.

methods.name: script_cache_new_script
methods.description: Creates a new script, initializes its Lua state, and registers it in the cache.

methods.name: script * script_cache_get_script(script_cache * cache,const buffer * name)
methods.description: Retrieves a script from the cache by name, creating it if it doesn't exist.

methods.name: lua_State * script_cache_check_script(script * const sc,int etag_flags)
methods.description: Checks whether the cached script is up-to-date based on its etag and reloads it if necessary.
